C1086.title: 7 Sentenced for Recruiting Players to Online Gambling Under Rebate Scheme
C1086.summary: Defendant Axin served as an agent for a gambling website, developed downstream agents through layered promotion, and formed a three-tier agency network. Bets accepted from subordinate agents and gamblers exceeded 4.82 million yuan, and illegal profit reached 100,000 yuan. Downstream participant Xiaojun and others also constituted the crime of opening a casino by acting as agents and accepting bets. After trial, Siming Court found that Axin and five others constituted the crime of opening a casino, while Laojia constituted gambling.
